Digital systems have no natural arrow of time, bits do not age. Mining proof-of-work introduces physical irreversibility, and the difficulty adjustment turns it into a probabilistic clock. The Bitcoin network is software that created a shared before and after on the Internet.

Every 2,016 blocks, the Bitcoin network measures how much the world has changed and adjusts its difficulty without changing its promise. Faster chips, cheaper energy, and more miners make the network stronger instead of making more bitcoin.
The first websites on the Internet looked like newspapers because nobody yet knew what a website wanted to become. Most Bitcoin products still look like banks for the same reason.

Bitcoin mining can travel to the source of electricity instead of requiring electricity to travel to industry. Energy infrastructure can begin earning before the roads, factories, and cities that may eventually grow around it.

A carpenter should not have to predict the winning companies in biotech, software, energy, and agriculture to bet on human progress. Bitcoin offers one simple way to save with the assumption that people everywhere will keep making useful things.
The world had to judge Bitcoin before it could ever judge its anonymous inventor. That may be the most important fact in all of computer science.
